schema:funding.schema:name: Planet Topers (BELSPO); FWO; Alexander von Humboldt Foundation; FWO/BOF-UGent

ada:mappingArea: Each map: 1450×600 µm = 870,000 µm²; total of 8 PMG olivines mapped
ada:detectionLimit: LODs reported in Table E1 (Appendix E) for 2D mapping: average of all individual pixel LODs (Na=1, Nb=10 per Longerich et al. 1996)
ada:withinSessionAnalyticalPrecisionAndA: Intermediate precision for mapping: most elements at ≥10 µg g⁻¹: 5–15% RSD; elements <10 µg g⁻¹: 5–30% RSD; assessed from repeated GRM mapping in 8 sessions over 1 year (n=8 for each element)
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: No systematic bias demonstrated; MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅ oxide sums after mapping varied 95–99 wt% (average near 100%); LA-ICP-MS Fa# values compared to EMPA values for 8 PMG (Fig. 5A shows good agreement)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Form / Analytical Substrate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: In situ — polished epoxy thick section (HELEX II two-volume cell)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Preparation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: PMG thick sections polished; HELEX II two-volume cell; C-coated for SEM then coating removed before LA

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Mass Resolution Setting
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Low resolution (M/ΔM = 300; cool plasma mapping)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Laser Spot Geometry
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: 20×20 µm square

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: 9 µm s⁻¹ (continuous raster)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Raster Line Spacing (Mapping Only)
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: 20 µm (contiguous; 20×20 µm square spot = line spacing equals spot width)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Carrier Gas and Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: He: MFC-1 (cell) 0.200–0.260 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 (cup) 0.220–0.385 l min⁻¹

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Ar make-up: 0.81–0.99 l min⁻¹ (mapping); N₂ explicitly not added

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Cool: 15 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.81 l min⁻¹ (mapping)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Signal Smoothing
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: None (no signal smoothing device; N₂ not added)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: ICP Tuning
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Daily tuning; cool plasma conditions optimized; N₂ explicitly not added to avoid N-based interferences

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Analysis Sequence
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: (i) Gas blanks → (ii) all glass GRMs for external calibration → (iii) 1–3 cosmic spherule unknowns → (iv) blanks → (v) all glass GRMs again

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Dwell Time per Mass
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: 0.01 s (10 ms) per nuclide; samples per peak: 10; duty cycle time: 1.944 s (14 nuclides)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Background Count Time
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Scans for gas blank: 10 per line (before each mapping line); 80 scans during ablation

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Uncertainty Propagation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Longerich et al. (1996) equation (3SD/S × √(1/Nb + 1/Na))

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Manual identification and exclusion of P-rich veinlet pixels from olivine averages; anomalous spikes from inclusions excluded per line

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Applied: triple mode detection; cross-calibration between pulse-counting and analog modes performed

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Memory Effect Mitigation
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Gas blank measured before each ablation line; adequate washout ensured by duty cycle timing

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: 100% oxide sum normalization (MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅) applied per pixel after IS-normalized external calibration (equations 3–4 in Appendix C1) to fix final mass balance

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Primary Calibration Standard Name
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Multiple glass GRMs used together for linear regression external calibration: NIST SRM 612, NIST SRM 614, USGS GSD-1G (synthetic), USGS GSE-1G (synthetic), USGS BHVO-2G, USGS BIR-1G (natural basalt glasses)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Secondary Reference Materials
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: MPI-DING glasses: GOR132-G, StHs6/80-G, T1-G; USGS: BCR-2G, BHVO-2G — measured as unknowns alongside samples and compared to GeoReM preferred values (Table 1 and Section 3.3)
